resources.string: Used when a connection is started without choosing, for example from the API.
Connect when the cable is plugged in
Connects over USB as soon as the K+DCAN cable is detected while BimmerData runs.
Internal storage › %1$s, visible in the Files app and over USB.
Every measurement being read when the recording starts.
Lets scripts and AI agents on the same network read live values, build dashboards and change settings, with the token below.
Plain HTTP on the local network: anyone on the same Wi-Fi who learns the token can use the API. Enable it on networks you trust (home, your own hotspot), not on public Wi-Fi.
No Wi-Fi or hotspot network. Connect the phone to Wi-Fi or turn on its hotspot; meanwhile only 127.0.0.1 answers (adb forward).
Scripts and AI agents using the current token will be refused until you give them the new one.
Live values, ECUs, layout, recordings, page pictures.
Add, change and delete pages and cards.
Connect and disconnect, recordings, connection settings.
Comes with the fault memory. Every write to the car will need your confirmation here and is refused while driving.
For an AI agent or a script
Give this line to your AI agent: it reads the specification and does the rest.
BimmerData REST API: %1$s, token: %2$s (send the header \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\"), OpenAPI spec: %3$s
The API answers while BimmerData is open, and in the background while it reads the car over USB. Otherwise Android may pause the app until you open it again.
